Historical polarized baseline used296 transferred AWC channel templates plus6 RMD profiles. Per-cell fitting can change scales; this is not302 independently measured neuron models. Server snapshot checks E120 base/effective conductances and template match.
9538 fitted scales/strengths; stereotypical fields, LEAK/RMD and anatomy fixed. Some are engineering priors, not independently measured values.

conclusion: Concrete implementation/execution gaps remain; more success flags on existing network-only runs do not close them.
